channel.title: Cast and Blast Journals
channel.description: Fishing and hunting trip notes from Doug Muraki, Sacramento, California.

item.title: A few days of big bass
item.description: Good friends, good water and big largemouth. A few days on the water with good friends, and the fish showed up.

item.title: Bass and stripers with the boys
item.description: Taking the kids out is the best part of owning a boat. Bass, crappie and a couple of stripers over a few summer mornings.

item.title: An offshore day
item.description: Rougher water, bigger gear, and a shark on the line. Different kind of day: heavier rods, open water, and a shark that came up next to the boat.

item.title: Duck season
item.description: Cold mornings, decoys out before light, and the blast half of cast and blast. Waders, decoys and a long wait in the tules for the birds to start moving.

item.title: A catfish morning
item.description: Flat water and a couple of heavy fish. A calm morning that turned into a couple of big catfish.

item.title: A salmon trip
item.description: A few days on the water with the boys and a dock full of fish. This one was a few days on a charter boat with the boys, rain gear on, pulling salmon and the occasional lingcod over the rail.

item.title: The biggest bass
item.description: The best largemouth we have put in the boat, pulled from years of photos. I went back through every fishing picture I have and pulled out the biggest bass.

item.title: Shoot time
item.description: Boat ride in the dark, then the birds start moving. A whole morning in the blind cut down to a few minutes.

item.title: Over the barrel
item.description: A few seconds at a time, straight down the barrel. Short clips from the camera mounted on the shotgun.

item.title: From the blind
item.description: Sunrise, decoys, and a lot of waiting. Phone clips from the tules, the field and the wait in between.
